notes: «قالا جميعا حدثنا شعبة» is the convergence; the tail runs from شعبة to the Companion Uthman, who relays the Prophet's words.
«أبي» has no name in the text (relation). «وابن، بشار» is one name split by a comma; the «و» is dropped.
«يحدث أبا بردة» is the scene, not a link. The remark «ليس في حديث غندر ...» is a wording variant and is left out.
